name: io.github.adekvatologiy/receipt-gate
title: Receipt Gate
description: Holds an agent's claim of completion until an independent adapter observes the promised state, and keeps the exact gap when it does not.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPT_GATE_LEDGER
environmentVariables.description: Path of the append-only, hash-chained ledger. Open promises are read back from it, so the same path across runs keeps the debts.

environmentVariables.name: RECEIPT_GATE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The root every adapter path stays inside. A configured path resolving outside it is refused.
